key_insight: PhysTrace localizes physical violations in generated videos by comparing history-conditioned expectations with observed events and describing the inconsistencies.
engineering_relevance: The framework helps diagnose physical consistency in video models used for prediction, planning, and action generation.
method: Use a multimodal large language model to generate physical expectations conditioned on video history.
Compare expectations with observed video windows to localize and describe violations without task-specific training.
Analyze reconstructed videos across diffusion/flow model timesteps for attribute- and noise-dependent violation patterns.
evidence_signal: On IntPhys2-Timing, which adds violation intervals to IntPhys2, PhysTrace achieves up to 70.7% Hit Rate across physical principles and outperforms compared methods in overall possible–impossible discrimination accuracy on IntPhys2.
watch_item: Reliance on MLLM-generated expectations may introduce errors; performance beyond the evaluated settings remains to be established.
paper_title: PhysTrace: Interpretable Temporal Evaluation of Physical Consistency in Video Generative Models
